response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure, but he lacks the core requirement of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions. His only AI-adjacent experience is a recent (since April 2025) role touching MCP code generators and agentic tooling, with no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, multi-agent frameworks, or cloud-native AI system design—all central to this Staff FDE GenAI role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering career with strong craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and public speaking/workshop experience
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of AI/GenAI-specific development; AI exposure is limited to the last ~1 year
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, or multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.)
No clear cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Azure) AI system design experience or Python proficiency mentioned

key_factors.factor: Recent MCP and agentic tooling exposure
